stories.title: [GO, UP, MX] Live Preview of Content in CMS
stories.description: Add Contentstack Live Preview support so editors see draft content update in real time and linked/tabular references show draft values. RETEST: a prior attempt at this exact fix was rejected by team-lead review with specific, concrete defects — see 'Prior review feedback' below. Do not repeat them.
acceptanceCriteria: Contentstack Stack options include a live_preview block with enable:true and preview_token set from CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN (NOT management_token — the delivery SDK's live_preview config reads preview_token; management_token is the wrong key and silently breaks preview).

Do NOT add a `host` field inside the live_preview block. Host is handled separately via Stack.setHost(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST), which already exists and is correct — adding host inside live_preview with a possibly-empty value can break requests.

ICommonContentstackConfig (src/interface/contentstack.ts) gains an optional live_preview field so preview context (live_preview/preview_hash) can flow through to Contentstack queries in setCommonConfig — this file IS in scope for this story; do not escalate it to a separate ticket.

New/extended vitest unit tests exist at src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts (the file ALREADY EXISTS on every codeline — extend it, do not create a new file at a different path) covering: (1) live_preview block present with preview_token when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is set, (2) live_preview absent when the token is unset, (3) setHost called with CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST when set, taking priority over CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST.

PRIOR REVIEW FEEDBACK (verbatim from the real rejection on this exact fix, orchestrations/logs/review-agent-AMSD-2041.log): 'the live_preview block uses management_token instead of the prescribed preview_token, which will cause the SDK to not recognize the preview token and live preview will silently fail'; 'no vitest unit tests exist for this feature'; 'host was added inside the live_preview block with a default empty string value, which was not prescribed and may cause runtime issues'; 'query config interfaces lack live_preview fields to forward preview context through to Contentstack queries'.

On a sibling codeline, the previous writer attempt REFUSED to edit src/interface/contentstack.ts, calling it 'outside my scope' and returning prose instead of a code change. That file IS in scope for this story on every codeline — make the actual edit, do not escalate or describe it in prose.

technicalNotes.failureReason: watchdog_timeout: story exceeded timeout twice and was skipped

facts: Editors see draft/unpublished Contentstack content update in real time when Live Preview is active (live_preview.enable=true, preview_token wired correctly).

Linked references and tabular/list content (e.g. content cards) render their DRAFT values under Live Preview, not just top-level fields — preview context must flow through query calls, not just the initial Stack options.
